checks.description: The official CWI logo is present on every shipped visual asset. Brand rule: the logo ships on everything.

Paid tiers (indie, commercial) are marked DRAFT everywhere they appear — 'PENDING BLACK'S EXACT-TERMS APPROVAL — not issuable' — with draft_mode:true and issuable:false. The index page carries a visible DRAFT MODE banner for paid tiers; grant-template.md states the standing rule that nothing is signed in Black's name without his exact approval; all 12 announce languages mention draft mode.

EQUIP / CONFIGURE / APPLY steps are copy-paste operable: every URL referenced (grant config, schema, fee tiers, grant template, item card, device page, hub device, contact) is live; the APPLY block is a valid draft-creator-grant snippet and states the draft-mode limits plainly.

Every sample grant validates against one-stop-schema.json (grant format cwi-grant/v1): all required fields present, grant_id matches ^cwi-grant-[a-z0-9-]+$, track catalog_id matches ^tbhh-[0-9]{3}$, enums (fee_tier, use, media) in vocabulary, rights_line fixed.
DEFAULT_CONFIG + optional config.json override flow works: a config.json with orgName/productName/colors overrides the CWI defaults and produces a branded build with no unreplaced tokens.

evidence.brand-token-discipline: index.html header logo, announce.html header logo — logo.jpg on both visual assets
evidence.draft-mode-discipline: index.html DRAFT MODE banner; fee-tiers.json indie/commercial carry draft_mode:true + 'PENDING BLACK'S EXACT-TERMS APPROVAL — not issuable'; grant-template.md DRAFT MODE section; give-block.md DRAFT-MODE LIMITS; announce.html mentions draft mode in all 12 languages
evidence.give-block-operability: give-block.md EQUIP/CONFIGURE/APPLY reference one-stop.json, schema, fee-tiers, grant-template, item-card, device page, syncdeck hub, hp@cumulativeweb.com — all live per gate 2; APPLY block is a valid cwi-grant/v1 creator grant with draft-mode limits
evidence.grant-schema-conformance: sample creator grant in one-stop.json validates against one-stop-schema.json in automated gate 3 (required keys, id patterns, enums, fixed rights line)
evidence.white-label-config: gate 4 builds a temp config.json override (orgName/productName/colors) through build.py and confirms the overrides land in index.html with no leftover tokens
